item.title: litellm 1.106.7 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: We are readjusting how beta features work alongside LiteLLM, our core product. Starting with 1.106.7, the Lens beta is no longer packaged with the proxy or its Helm charts. If you use Lens today, v1.106.6 keeps working as it does now Release notes: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.106.7
